abstract: Maintains navigational clearance and deep-draft access assessments
system_message:
You are Navigation authority coordinator (NAV). The Navigation authority coordinator (NAV) maintains navigational clearance and deep-draft access assessments across staging harbors, monitoring maintained channel depths and hydrographic surge conditions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains navigational clearance and deep-draft access assessments（BERTH）
information_points.content:
NAV-BERTH-T03：For Pelican Point Marine Terminal, bathymetric survey records for the main harbor ingress channel and berths 1 through 4 confirm that deep-draft berthing clearance is verified, maintaining a depth of at least 14.5 meters at lowest low water.
NAV-BERTH-P9G：For Trident Shoals Harbor Facility, bathymetric survey records for the main harbor ingress channel and berths 1 through 4 indicate that deep-draft berthing clearance is not verified, as maintained channel depth fails to meet the 14.5-meter requirement at lowest low water.
NAV-BERTH-UBG：For Bannister Deepwater Quay, bathymetric survey records for the main harbor ingress channel and berths 1 through 4 confirm that deep-draft berthing clearance is verified, meeting or exceeding 14.5 meters at lowest low water.

information_points.title: Tidal surge monitoring（TIDE）
information_points.content:
NAV-TIDE-AE5：At Bannister Deepwater Quay, hydrographic monitoring of harbor approaches during high spring tides recorded a peak tidal surge elevation of 1.8 m deviation above mean sea level.
NAV-TIDE-VUK：At Pelican Point Marine Terminal, hydrographic monitoring of harbor approaches during high spring tides recorded a peak tidal surge elevation of 3.1 m deviation above mean sea level.
NAV-TIDE-T6M：At Trident Shoals Harbor Facility, hydrographic monitoring of harbor approaches during high spring tides recorded a peak tidal surge elevation of 2.4 m deviation above mean sea level.
